lessons.trigger_condition: A fixed child-test count rejected new valid cases, repeated immutable Git checks slowed historical suites, and overlong fingerprints could be truncated into valid evidence.
lessons.prevention_rule: Execute every discovered child test; cache only checkout/ref/path-scoped immutable Git objects; always recheck current proof, source, ancestry and dirty state; retain and reject malformed fingerprints.
validation_required: Invalid input and actual completed-outcome regressions, native receipt integrity, date provenance, long Retry-After, exact historical and descendant source lineage
lessons.safety_boundary: No invented labels, weakened source pins, cloud learning, live grading auto-enable or physical-device claims.
